Greta Thunberg Criticizes UN Climate Summits as 'Greenwashed'

Climate activist Greta Thunberg has criticized the UN's Conference of the Parties (COP) climate summits, referring to them as 'greenwashed circuses' and 'hypocrisy'. She made these remarks during COP31, stating that 'everything we love is at stake'. Thunberg's comments were directed at world leaders participating in the climate talks.
